SELECT d.fiscal_year, f.channel_id, f.channel_code, CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN 'store' ELSE cast(s.store_id as varchar) END sid, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net, sum(f.quantity<=0::int) nonpos, sum(case when f.staff_purchase_flag then net_amount else 0 end) staffnet
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT d.fiscal_year, CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN 'store' ELSE cast(s.store_id as varchar) END sid, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, min(return_date), max(return_date), count(distinct return_line_id) dist, sum(case when r.sales_line_id in (select sales_line_id from fact_sales_line f2 where f2.channel_id in (2,3) or f2.channel_code='WB') then r.refund_net else 0 end) refund_of_web_sales
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH rpt AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, CASE WHEN store_id<900 THEN 'store' ELSE cast(store_id as varchar) END sid, sum(net_sales_before_returns) gross_rpt, sum(returns_net) ret_rpt, sum(net_sales) net_rpt, count(*) n, count(distinct (business_date, store_id)) dn
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY ALL),
 sl AS (
 SELECT d.fiscal_year, CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN 'store' ELSE cast(s.store_id as varchar) END sid, sum(net_amount) sales_all, sum(case when staff_purchase_flag then 0 else net_amount end) sales_nostaff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT * FROM rpt FULL JOIN sl USING (fiscal_year, sid) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, w.status, w.fulfilment_type, count(*) n, count(distinct f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(case when cast(f.sale_ts_utc as date)<>f.sale_date then f.net_amount else 0 end) tz_diff_net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND s.store_id=900
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
WITH cur AS (
  -- current region per store (restates the old South/East assignments to today's regions)
  SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current
),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN 'Web shop' ELSE c.region END AS line, f.net_amount AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN cur c ON c.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND s.store_id <> 999
),
refunds AS (
  -- refunds of web-sold lines go to the web line wherever they were booked
  SELECT d.fiscal_year,
         CASE WHEN orig_store.store_id = 900 THEN 'Web shop' ELSE c.region END AS line,
         -r.refund_net AS amount
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN cur c ON c.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN fact_sales_line o ON o.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store orig_store ON orig_store.store_key = o.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND s.store_id <> 999
),
allrows AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM refunds),
agg AS (
  SELECT line AS region,
         round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN amount END),2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
         round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2024/25' THEN amount END),2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25
  FROM allrows GROUP BY line)
SELECT region, net_sales_fy2025_26, net_sales_fy2024_25,
       round(100.0*(net_sales_fy2025_26/net_sales_fy2024_25 - 1),1) AS growth_pct
FROM agg ORDER BY region
